QuestInfo.name: Mason the Collector
QuestInfo.0: I should meet Mason, who newly moved into a previously-empty house at Ludibrium.
QuestInfo.1: The bird with an odd way of talking, Mason the Collector is always busy looking for something to collect. It especially has a fondness for sparkling objects, and apparently found the Aurora Marble at the Warped Path of Time. Hmmm... Wonder who has that item? \n\n#t4031189::# #b#c4031189#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: At the Warped Path of Time, I took out the Lazy Buffies, collected the Aurora Marble, and handed it to Mason.

0.0: A marble that emits a mysterious sparkle... I saw with my very own eyes; I can't help, I want it! I want Aurora Marble! I want it... Get that marble for me.

yes.0: Are you really going to get it for me? I went to the #bWarped Path of Time#k before to collect some items, and that's where I saw it... and it was right there on the ground!
yes.1: Aurora Marble, very mystifying. I was ready to take it when someone else took it and ran away with it! Very angry now, thinking about it. I want the marble, and I want it now. \n\n#i4031189# 1 #t4031189# #b#k

no.0: If you get me the Aurora Marble, I'll give you something from my collection. Get me that sparkling marble.

1.0: You may find yourself staring at that mystifying light. Did you bring it? Show it to me.

yes.0: This is it. Yes, the beautiful, mystifying colors. This marble deserves to be part of my collection. I now give you an item from the collection as I promised..

item.0: No. Not it. You don't have the marble I am looking for!
